spine.claim: Suffering is not caused by life events but by believing the voice in your head: pain is the first arrow, suffering the second.
A thought is a spark that arrives free; thinking is the effortful, ego-driven rumination — and emotions are just a check-engine light for it.
Positive thinking is another fire; flow and mushin show intelligence works best with the thinker out of the way.
Circumstances are neutral until labelled; goals driven by desperation burn out while inspiration attracts.
Peace is the default — let the mud settle; you are the sky, not the weather. Use thinking as a tool, then put it down.
